rows.text: Greetings. Have you noticed? It's raining in Seafeld City.
rows.speaker: Umbralle

rows.text: But it's perfectly sunny out, isn't it?
Take a look right above my head. Can't you see the constant rain?
rows.speaker: Umbralle

rows.text: Umbrellas need rain just like furbos need to make trouble... Uh, I mean, just like a blank page needs a poem.
rows.speaker: Umbralle

rows.text: Yeah, a banana just committed a murder.
Oh, so you've heard? They've taken out even more people than the Herald of Death! That wicked banana company must be stopped!
rows.speaker: Umbralle

rows.text: I'm going to interview... Uh, I mean, represent the victims in court. But they're making it impossible! The world's gone to the dogs.
rows.speaker: Umbralle

rows.text: Mr. Lawyer, so you're one of those artsy types?

Who says a lawyer can't be artsy? I'll have you know I once wrote a hundred-thousand-word literary review for a Planarcadian Journal C in one night... Wait... there goes my work brain again. Why on earth was I writing articles?
rows.speaker: Umbralle

rows.text: Hold on... are you actually Umbralle?
Hehe, the jig's up! I've decided to "fur-go" my responsibilities, and my name is "Um-Breaking-Free"!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: *sigh*... Being a furbo only gets you so far. We can "shift shapes" all day, but humans always see right through us. But a lawyer can "shift narratives" so smoothly that even Planarcadia's laws can't keep up!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Come on, boss! Today, I'll show you what it truly means to push my limits!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Ugh... I didn't even get to break a sweat before you took me down, boss...
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Was a fight really necessary?
I just thought we'd warm up a bit... I heard that big-shot umbrella lawyer was quite the fighter?
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Not bad at all... for a furbo.
Really? Thanks for the compliment, boss!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: So, what's with the umbrella lawyer look anyway?
Because he looks awesome! And besides...
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Once I've got his vibe down, I can just pretend to be him whenever the magazine office gets into a jam. That'll scare the troublemakers off for sure!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Don't worry. Those shady types are terrified of lawyers anyway, and he's the biggest name in the business!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: You can actually use shapeshifting for that?
Of course! Did you really think we furbos didn't care about the magazine's reputation? I'm offended!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Gotcha. I'll be counting on you next time!
On it! Those shady types are terrified of lawyers anyway, and he's the biggest name in the business!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!

rows.text: Take care, boss! I'll keep practicing. Who knows? Maybe I'll even pass the bar for real!
rows.speaker: Furnobo!
